newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia weighs on thin Helsinki ahead of Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Nokia weighs on thin Helsinki ahead of Q1 earnings.

text.p: Finnish shares were lower in thin early afternoon trade as investors stayed on the sidelines ahead of Nokia's first quarter earnings report due on Tuesday, brokers said.
"It is nothing but waiting for Nokia," said one broker.
By 1330/1030 GMT, Nokia was down 4.50 markka at 302.00, or slightly above its Friday's close in New York. Turnover was fairly active at some 50 million markka.
Enso was off 0.50 markka at 43.00 markka following news that it had acquired a 50.4 percent stake in German paper company E.Holtzmann for 1.8 billion markka.
"Investors are not really sure how to interpret this deal until the specifics of the financing are konwn," one said.
Industrial wiring maker PK Cables was up one markka at 70.00, in brisk trade after the group showed a 46 percent rise in Q1 profits.
Pharmaceuticals group Orion was supported by news that it had sought marketing approval for its Parkinson's disease drug entacapone from the European authority.
Turnover was lively for Orion at over 33 million markka.
